name: Vying for Versailles
source:
Can a poor noblewoman survive – and even thrive – in the scheming court of Louis XIV? 

Play as Renée de Noailles in an alternate 1660s Versailles, where history is rewritten and loyalties are tested. The King’s valet, Alexandre Bontemps, forces you into the Sun Court – will you find love, power, or both?

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Vying_for_Versailles]romance-club.fandom[/url]
